name: Parental Bond
description: When you execute an instantaneous damaging move that requires at least one attack roll against one target, you may use your bonus action this turn to execute the same move again against the same target at no PP cost. If you do, the damage dealt by the second execution is halved and does not benefit from the MOVE modifier, STAB, or bonus damage from items, other abilities, feats, or from any other damage bonuses.
